actors.name: Wholesale Freight Forwarder
actors.description: Top-level party (AGS, DHL, Mondiale) with visibility over all HBLs auto-assigned from Maximus.
actors.auth: Username + password. No SSO. Can self-register.

responsibilities.description: View all HBLs auto-assigned from Maximus with milestone, HBL status, payment, delegation, and booking info.
Search by HBL# to find specific shipments.
Delegate booking responsibility to an existing FF or Transport Carrier. Per HBL — if delegated, WFF cannot also book directly on that same HBL. Delegation is allowed before unpack (BR-001).

Book pickup directly without delegating — select slot, pay, add driver/truck details. Per HBL — if booking directly, WFF cannot also delegate that same HBL. Requires HBL milestone "unpacked" or later (BR-001).
Upload Delivery Order for downstream FF/TC enforcement.
Flag an HBL as under-bond. Manually set in portal — not synced from Maximus.

actors.name: Freight Forwarder
actors.description: Downstream/tiered forwarder who receives delegated HBLs and manages DOs.
actors.auth: Magic link + OTP. No account creation. Secure link sent to nominated email on delegation. Portal access scoped to assigned shipments only. Link expires on collection.

responsibilities.description: View assigned HBLs with milestones, HBL status, and release-authority indicators.
Upload or ensure required DOs are available. Required unless free-release or under-bond.
Nominate/select a carrier from the ACFS-maintained party registry. Use search + autocomplete to find parties.
Flag an HBL as under-bond. Manually set in portal.

actors.name: Transport Carrier
actors.description: Books pickup slots, provides driver/truck details, pays fees. Can combine HBLs from different WFFs into a single booking.
actors.auth: Magic link + OTP. No account creation. Secure link sent to nominated email on delegation. Portal access scoped to assigned shipments only. Link expires on collection.

responsibilities.description: View delegated HBLs ready for pickup.
Select available pickup window and book slot. Booking flow is full-screen/modal with progressive summary, 2-3 steps max.
Provide driver name, license, truck rego, and contact details. Search + autocomplete for existing drivers.
Pay booking fee (minimum charge + volumetric) via Stripe embedded checkout.

actors.name: One-off Customer
actors.description: External party collecting a single shipment. No persistent account or history.
actors.auth: Magic link + OTP. No account creation. Minimal status page via magic link. Link expires when shipment is collected. Repeat users should be onboarded as a proper party role.

responsibilities.description: View status of assigned shipment via magic link.
Book pickup slot and pay fee if applicable.

actors.name: ACFS Internal
actors.description: Internal ACFS warehouse staff who manage operations, configure availability, and oversee bookings and delegations.

responsibilities.description: Edit HBL details and update milestones/statuses manually when corrections are needed.
Assign a Freight Forwarder to an HBL on behalf of a WFF.
Edit booking details — update driver/truck info, add/remove HBLs, or cancel bookings.
Edit pickup details — reassign windows, override slot constraints.
Edit delegation — reassign or revoke delegation between parties.
Configure pickup slot availability — set density thresholds per site, time slots, blackout dates via holiday calendar overlay. Cannot change slots with existing bookings (Phase 1).
Override missing DO requirement. Restricted to certain ACFS roles. Audit trail with reason required. One-time per HBL, lives until collected.
FOC rebooking for no-shows. ACFS admin only. Overrides all fees. Reason/justification required for audit trail.
Flag an HBL as under-bond.
Partially process bookings — clear HBLs proceed while blocked ones are rebooked separately.

actors.name: Gatehouse
actors.description: ACFS gatehouse staff who verify and confirm physical vehicle entry/exit for pickups.

responsibilities.description: Verify booking reference, driver identity, and truck rego on arrival.
Confirm vehicle exit to mark booking as collected.

entities.name: House Bill of Lading (HBL)
entities.description: Primary tracking unit for a shipment. Sourced from Maximus via periodic batch (once or twice daily). Two orthogonal dimensions: milestone (physical progress) and HBL status (delegation/booking state).

key_fields.name: weight_kg
key_fields.description: Weight measurement for fee calculation (max of weight vs volume determines charge).

key_fields.name: milestone
key_fields.description: Physical progress milestone. Linear progression. Sourced from Maximus batch sync.
key_fields.warn: Milestone list is based on PM knowledge — pending client confirmation (OQ-021).

key_fields.name: hbl_status
key_fields.description: Delegation/booking status. Separate dimension from milestone. "delegated" and "booked" are NOT milestones.

key_fields.name: customs_clearance_status
key_fields.description: Customs clearance state. Shown in HBL table. Sourced from Maximus.

key_fields.name: under_bond
key_fields.description: Flag — NOT a lifecycle state. Manually set by WFF/FF/ACFS in portal. Skips DO requirement. Not synced from Maximus.
key_fields.warn: Full under-bond concept needs deeper clarification (OQ-025).

key_fields.name: storage_fee_flag
key_fields.description: Visual indicator that storage fees apply. Shown in HBL table as a flag, not an amount.

key_fields.name: release_type
key_fields.description: Determines DO requirements. Free release removes DO requirement for that tier.
key_fields.warn: Full list of release types pending client confirmation (OQ-022).

transitions.trigger: Goods physically picked up from warehouse
transitions.guard: Booking in "processed" state + gatehouse confirms exit

lifecycle.warn: Milestones only — delegation and booking are tracked via hbl_status, a separate dimension. Delegation can happen at any milestone (BR-001). Booking requires milestone "unpacked" or later (BR-001).

entities.name: Booking
entities.description: Groups one or more HBLs into a pickup window with driver/truck details. HBLs from different WFFs can be combined in a single booking.

key_fields.name: hbl_ids
key_fields.description: HBLs included in this booking. Can span multiple WFFs.

key_fields.name: fee_amount
key_fields.description: Calculated per HBL individually (flat minimum + per-HBL volumetric using max of weight vs volume), then summed.
key_fields.warn: Flat rate vs percentage still undecided by client (see OQ-023).

transitions.trigger: Carrier confirms and pays via Stripe embedded checkout
transitions.guard: All HBLs at milestone "unpacked" or later + release conditions met

transitions.trigger: ACFS validates all DOs and marks ready. Partial processing allowed — clear HBLs proceed, blocked ones rebook separately.

journeys.name: Carrier Books a Pickup
preconditions: Carrier has been delegated one or more HBLs via magic link + OTP
HBLs are at milestone "unpacked" or later
Release conditions are met (DO validated or under-bond flag set)

steps.title: Select HBLs and choose slot
steps.detail: Carrier views delegated HBLs, selects one or more for pickup (can combine across WFFs), and chooses available pickup window. System shows density indicator (low/moderate/high) per slot — does not block booking. Full-screen/modal flow with progressive summary.

steps.title: Enter details and pay
steps.detail: Carrier provides driver name, license, truck rego, contact phone (search + autocomplete for existing drivers). System calculates fee (minimum + volumetric per HBL). Payment via Stripe embedded checkout.

steps.title: Confirmation
steps.detail: Booking confirmed with reference number. All HBLs move to hbl_status "booked".

journeys.success_outcome: Booking is confirmed with a scheduled pickup window, and all HBLs have hbl_status "booked".

business_rules.description: Delegation can happen at any milestone — no unpack gate. Booking requires all included HBLs to have milestone "unpacked" or later. This means delegate button is always enabled; book button is gated by milestone.
Under-bond HBLs skip the DO requirement. Under-bond is a boolean flag set manually by WFF/FF/ACFS staff in the portal. Not synced from Maximus. Verification happens outside the portal.
business_rules.warn: Full under-bond lifecycle needs deeper clarification (see OQ-025).

business_rules.description: DO rules follow a 3-level hierarchy: WFF → FF → Carrier/Customer. Each level uploads its own DO independently — no inheritance or cascading. Bottom-most party must have ALL DOs present across all tiers. Free release removes the DO requirement for that tier.
WFF can either delegate or book directly per HBL — never both on the same HBL. Mutual exclusivity enforced at the HBL level.
Slot cutoffs are absolute date/time per slot, not hour-based. ACFS sets a specific cutoff date and time for each slot. Per-site configuration.
No-show rebooking is ACFS admin only and free of charge (FOC). Overrides all fees. Reason/justification required for audit trail. Carrier must call ACFS — no self-service.
ACFS can partially process bookings — HBLs that have cleared customs proceed while blocked ones are rebooked separately.

constraints.constraint: Pickup slots have NO hard capacity limits. Density indicator only (low/moderate/high based on configurable thresholds). Does NOT block booking. Per-site configuration.
Slots with existing bookings cannot be modified in Phase 1. Blackout dates enforced via holiday calendar overlay.
Refunds are completely outside the portal. Handled offline by ACFS. Portal is refund-agnostic.

open_questions.question: How is Tier-2 FF data sourced? Are they registered in Maximus or only in the portal?
open_questions.reason: Delegation flow depends on knowing which FFs exist in the system.
open_questions.resolution: Global registry maintained by ACFS. One-time bulk upload from AGS portal/party manager into the portal local DB. No Maximus sync. WFF manually assigns FF per HBL via delegation.

open_questions.question: What is the exact fee method — flat rate per HBL or percentage of declared value?
open_questions.reason: Fee calculation logic in the booking flow depends on this decision.
open_questions.resolution: Flat minimum + per-HBL volumetric charge. Calculation is per HBL individually (max of weight vs volume), then summed. Flat vs percentage split is pending client decision — build for flat with configurable override.

open_questions.question: Can a WFF both delegate and book directly on the same HBL?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether the UI allows both actions or enforces mutual exclusivity per HBL.
open_questions.resolution: Either/or per HBL. WFF either delegates or books directly — never both on the same HBL.

open_questions.question: How do FF and Transport Carrier authenticate?
open_questions.reason: Auth method determines onboarding flow, UI entry points, and session management.
open_questions.resolution: Magic link + OTP for all external parties after WFF. Secure link sent to nominated email on delegation. OTP verification on the same email. No account creation. Portal access scoped to assigned shipments only.

open_questions.question: Does the one-off customer get a dashboard or booking history?
open_questions.reason: Affects whether one-off users need persistent state or session-only access.
open_questions.resolution: No dashboard. Minimal status page via magic link. Link expires when shipment is collected. No account, no history. Repeat users should be onboarded as a proper party role.

open_questions.question: How fresh is the data from Maximus?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether UI needs real-time indicators or can rely on periodic state.
open_questions.resolution: Periodic batch — once or twice daily. No real-time integration. Portal fetches from custom cargo table starting 7 days before vessel arrival.

open_questions.question: Can an HBL skip delegation and go straight from unpacked to booked?
open_questions.reason: Affects state machine transitions and whether delegation is a required step.
open_questions.resolution: Always valid. WFF can book directly without delegating (e.g., DHL delivering to customers themselves). No precondition on delegation.

open_questions.question: How does the portal know an HBL is under-bond?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether under-bond status is synced from Maximus or manually flagged.
open_questions.resolution: Manual flag set by WFF or FF staff in the portal. ACFS internal staff can also flag it. Not synced from Maximus.

open_questions.question: What is the 3-level DO hierarchy — does it cascade or is each level independent?
open_questions.reason: Determines upload UX and validation logic for delivery orders.
open_questions.resolution: Each level uploads independently. No inheritance or cascading. 3 tiers = 3 separate DOs. Bottom-most party must have all DOs present. Free release removes the DO requirement for that tier.

open_questions.question: What are the ACFS override rules for missing DOs?
open_questions.reason: Determines role restrictions, audit requirements, and override lifecycle.
open_questions.resolution: Only certain ACFS roles can override. Audit trail with reason is required. Override is one-time per HBL and lives until the HBL is collected.

open_questions.question: Can HBLs from different WFFs be combined in one booking?
open_questions.reason: Affects booking selection UI and potentially the auth model for carriers.
open_questions.resolution: Yes. A carrier can combine HBLs from different WFFs into a single booking.

open_questions.question: What payment integration is expected for Phase 1?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether to build a custom payment UI or embed a third-party checkout.
open_questions.resolution: Stripe embedded checkout. No custom payment UI. Use Stripe interface directly. Storage fees may be added as a line item if data is available.

open_questions.question: How are refunds handled?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether the portal needs refund state, UI, or processing.
open_questions.resolution: Completely outside the portal. Refund-agnostic. Handled offline by ACFS.

open_questions.question: What are the booking and change cut-off rules?
open_questions.reason: Determines slot configuration UI and booking validation logic.
open_questions.resolution: Cutoffs are absolute date/time per slot — not hour-based. ACFS sets a specific cutoff date and time for each slot. Per-site configuration. No-show rebooking is ACFS admin only, free of charge for Phase 1.

open_questions.question: What does the ACFS processing workflow look like?
open_questions.reason: Determines the ops dashboard layout, queue structure, and validation sequence.
open_questions.resolution: Data arrives 7 days before vessel via Maximus batch. Portal tracks milestones from on_vessel to collected. ACFS can partially process bookings — clear HBLs proceed, blocked ones rebook separately.

open_questions.question: What slot configuration options does ACFS need?
open_questions.reason: Determines the admin configuration UI for pickup windows.
open_questions.resolution: Flexible time slots (2-4/day, overlapping allowed). No hard capacity — density indicator instead (threshold-based, low/moderate/high, non-blocking). Blackout dates via holiday calendar overlay. Per-site config. Cannot change slots with existing bookings in Phase 1.

open_questions.question: What does FOC rebooking look like?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether free rebooking needs a separate flow or is an admin override.
open_questions.resolution: ACFS admin only. Overrides all fees. Reason/justification required for audit trail.

open_questions.question: Single app with role-based routing or separate apps per actor?
open_questions.reason: Determines deployment architecture, routing strategy, and shared component scope.
open_questions.resolution: Single app with role-based routing.

open_questions.question: What is the auth strategy across all actor types?
open_questions.reason: Determines auth implementation, session management, and middleware design.
open_questions.resolution: WFF: username/password. FF, Carrier, one-off customer: magic link + OTP (no account). ACFS and Gatehouse: SSO via OAuth/Okta.

open_questions.question: What happens when a WFF requests a missing HBL be added?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether a request flow is needed or just search.
open_questions.resolution: No request flow exists. WFF can search by HBL only. Missing HBL requests are not part of the BRD or Phase 1 scope.

open_questions.question: What are the confirmed milestone statuses from the client?
open_questions.reason: Current list (on_vessel, at_wharf, in_yard, unpacked, collected) is based on PM knowledge. Client confirmation needed before finalising the state machine.

open_questions.question: What is the full list of release types and their DO rules?
open_questions.reason: Only free_release is confirmed. Need the complete list to build release-authority logic and DO validation.

open_questions.question: Is the fee method flat rate or percentage of declared value?
open_questions.reason: Per-HBL volumetric calculation is confirmed, but the rate structure (flat vs percentage) is pending client business decision.

open_questions.question: Will the auth model for FF/Carrier change from magic links to a persistent login?
open_questions.reason: Cross-WFF booking requires carriers to see HBLs from multiple delegations. Magic links are scoped to a single delegation. A persistent login model may be required.

open_questions.question: What is the exact definition and lifecycle of under-bond shipments?
open_questions.reason: Under-bond is confirmed as a flag (not a lifecycle state) that skips DO requirements. But the full concept — triggers, verification steps, and edge cases — needs deeper clarification for implementation.
